name: Lady Jessica
text: When you play a [{Bene Gesserit}] card: You may exhaust this leader. If you do, exhaust an enemy non-leader ground unit that costs 4 or less.
subtitle: Bene Gesserit
backText:
[Restore 2]
[When Deployed:] Return a [{Bene Gesserit}] or [{Fremen}] unit from your discard pile to your hand.
When a friendly Spice token is defeated: Heal 2 damage from a unit or base.
